credits.title: Montpellier
credits.overview: In the year 1721, Sebastià Calaf, a mercenary grayed by war, tracketh a ravenous beast alongside his nephew Jaume, knowing not what foul horror awaiteth their steps.

credits.title: Sempre, sempre
credits.overview: Years after separating, Martina and Gerard meet again by chance in Montjuic. The words they say and don’t say open a crack, and memories erupt: a morning at a garden center, a persistent phone call, a chance to escape the consequences of their decisions.

credits.title: L'última cita
credits.overview: Javi's parents break up after trying the swinger lifestyle, just as his girlfriend, Silvia, asks him to experiment as a couple. Javi decides to break up with her but, unable to do so, hires the services of a special restaurant.

credits.title: Mai parlarem de nosaltres
credits.overview: Two friends spend a weekend together before one of them leaves to live in France. During those two days, a series of events will put their true friendship to the test.

credits.title: While at War
credits.overview: Salamanca, Spain, 1936. In the early days of the military rebellion that began the Spanish Civil War (1936-39), writer Miguel de Unamuno supports the uprising in the hope that the prevailing political chaos will end. But when the confrontation becomes bloody, Unamuno must question his initial position.

credits.title: A March to Remember
credits.overview: Vitoria, Basque Country, Spain, March 3, 1976. After several months of protests demanding decent working conditions, a general strike is called. Thousands of workers gather at the church of San Francisco while a hundred heavily armed policemen wait to act.

credits.title: Brava
credits.overview: Janine works in a bank giving credits to clients to buy houses and receives the offer of a promotion to work in a future branch in China for which she takes Mandarin classes. credits.title: Black Snow
credits.overview: Accused of killing his brother during adolescence, Salvador lives alone in the middle of Patagonia. Several decades later, his brother Marcos and his sister-in-law Laura, come to convince him to sell the lands they share by inheritance.

credits.title: The Next Skin
credits.overview: A teenager who went missing and was presumed dead returns home after eight years to find a family deeply affected by his disappearance. Gradually, doubts arise about whether he really is the missing boy or an impostor.

credits.title: Ismael
credits.overview: An aging couple follows after Ismael Tchou, an 8-year-old, who is trying to find his way to his estranged biological father all by himself.

credits.title: The Last Days
credits.overview: A mysterious epidemic spreads across the planet. Humanity develops an irrational fear of open spaces that causes instant death. Soon, the world population is trapped inside buildings. As Barcelona descends into chaos, Marc sets off on a quest to find Julia, his missing girlfriend, without ever going outside.

credits.title: El criminal
credits.overview: Daniel is a married man who is leaving the city and moving to the coast where his wife and his son await him to start a new life away from the city stress.
